answer.book: Robert Rollock's Tractatus de vocatione efficaci (Edinburgh, 1597): front matter (dedication to James VI, printer's letter, Beza's letter, method of theological commonplaces), the treatise in 38 numbered chapters with a few unnumbered subheads, an appended set of questions on the modes of revelation, and a printed table of chapters.
